attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado military retirement exemption (2025). Age-based: Under 55 = $15k, 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, Colorado DOR. Skeleton table: conditions populated as real EL but actions block intentionally empty pending authorship — exemption assignment to result.co_military_retirement_exemption not yet wired up. See issue #446.

Colorado pension/annuity subtraction (2025). Age-based: 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Applies to pension and annuity income not already excluded (e.g., not military retirement which has separate exemption). Source: Colorado DOR Form DR 0104. Skeleton table: condition populated as real EL but actions block intentionally empty pending authorship — subtraction assignment to result.co_pension_subtraction not yet wired up. See issue #446.

Colorado state income tax (2025). Flat 4.40% rate (C.R.S. § 39-22-104) applied to federal AGI. CO has no standard deduction; tax = AGI * 0.044. Richer CO-specific subtractions (Social Security, military retirement, pension/annuity per CO_Pension_Subtraction / CO_Military_Retirement_Exemption) are computed in the sibling tables and stored separately; they're not subtracted here yet — a follow-up will integrate them. Writes result.co_taxable_income and result.co_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.co_tax = 0; set result.co_taxable_income = 0; add " Colorado Tax Calculation (Form DR 0104) - flat 4.40%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.co_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef " Colorado Tax Calculation (Form DR 0104) - flat 4.40%" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.co_taxable_income = the maximum of result.agi and 0.0; set result.co_tax = result.co_taxable_income * co_tax_rate; add " CO taxable income: $" + result.co_taxable_income to job.audit_trail; add " CO state tax (4.40%): $" + result.co_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 fmax cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef result.co_taxable_income co_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.co_tax xdef " CO taxable income: $" result.co_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " CO state tax (4.40%): $" result.co_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado Earned Income Tax Credit. Refundable credit equal to 35-50% of federal EITC. Minimum 35%, up to 50% based on economic growth. Expanded eligibility to age 18+ and ITIN holders. Per Colorado DOR 2025. Source: https://tax.colorado.gov/ctc-eitc. Skeleton table: needs authorship. Conditions/actions intentionally empty pending follow-up; CO EITC rate (35-50%) is not yet declared in CO_edd.xml and the credit-application logic is not wired up. See issue #446.
